<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bbsky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0b1410"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#0a100c"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#050705"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bblight" cx="0.5" cy="0.08" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f5e6a3" stop-opacity="0.20"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#f5e6a3" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#bbsky)"/>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#bblight)"/>

  <!-- CRT scanlines -->
  <g stroke="#12241a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35">
    <line x1="0" y1="60" x2="640" y2="60"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="120" x2="640" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="640" y2="180"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="240" x2="640" y2="240"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="300" x2="640" y2="300"/>
  </g>

  <!-- outfield fence + home plate -->
  <path d="M0 252 Q320 214 640 252" fill="none" stroke="#1c3327" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M300 300 L340 300 L340 314 L320 326 L300 314 Z" fill="#1d3226" stroke="#2f5340" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- cracked baseball, upper-right -->
  <g transform="translate(548,104)">
    <circle r="54" fill="#e9e3d4" stroke="#b9b3a2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M-38 -38 A54 54 0 0 1 -38 38" fill="none" stroke="#c23b30" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M38 -38 A54 54 0 0 0 38 38" fill="none" stroke="#c23b30" stroke-width="3"/>
    <g stroke="#c23b30" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="-34" y1="-26" x2="-27" y2="-24"/><line x1="-36" y1="-13" x2="-29" y2="-12"/>
      <line x1="-37" y1="-1" x2="-30" y2="-1"/><line x1="-36" y1="11" x2="-29" y2="10"/>
      <line x1="-34" y1="24" x2="-27" y2="22"/>
      <line x1="34" y1="-26" x2="27" y2="-24"/><line x1="36" y1="-13" x2="29" y2="-12"/>
      <line x1="37" y1="-1" x2="30" y2="-1"/><line x1="36" y1="11" x2="29" y2="10"/>
      <line x1="34" y1="24" x2="27" y2="22"/>
    </g>
    <path d="M-16 -46 L-4 -16 L-12 6 L4 36" fill="none" stroke="#7a2b23" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- crossed bats, lower-left -->
  <g transform="translate(96,244) rotate(-22)" fill="#5a4326" stroke="#3a2c19" stroke-width="1">
    <rect x="-7" y="-66" width="14" height="112" rx="7"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="42" width="10" height="15" rx="3" fill="#3a2c19"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(96,244) rotate(22)" fill="#6b5230" stroke="#3a2c19" stroke-width="1">
    <rect x="-7" y="-66" width="14" height="112" rx="7"/>
    <rect x="-5" y="42" width="10" height="15" rx="3" fill="#3a2c19"/>
  </g>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="40" y="150" fill="#eef0e8" font-size="80" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="3">DEADBALL</text>
  <rect x="42" y="167" width="332" height="3" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <text x="44" y="195" fill="#f5a623" font-size="18" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="5">COLDWATER LEAGUE BASEBALL</text>

  <!-- footer band -->
  <rect x="0" y="322" width="640" height="38" fill="#0e1a13"/>
  <rect x="0" y="322" width="640" height="2" fill="#c23b30"/>
  <text x="20" y="347" fill="#8fae9a" font-size="15" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="3">NINE INNINGS · NO SURVIVORS</text>
  <text x="620" y="347" fill="#eef0e8" font-size="15" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="2" text-anchor="end">with CHIP VEGA</text>
</svg>
